title: Package delivered confirmation
description: Confirm that a package was delivered and invite customers to report problems. Delivery confirmation WhatsApp template for stores.
notes: Utility works here because it reports a completed event. Offer a quick reply for problems rather than a review ask, which is promotional.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your order *#{{order_id}}* was delivered on {{date}}. If anything looks wrong, tell us and we'll sort it out.
